headline: Earnings jump as prices rise and a segment swings to profit
summary_short: Q2 2026 diluted EPS was $1.59 (+32.5% y/y, +71.0% q/q) as revenue rose 9.9% y/y to $2,513M; gross profit grew 10.7% y/y to $560M and net income rose 30.7% y/y to $183M, helped by a swing to profit in the Chemical Intermediates segment.
summary_long: Revenue grew 9.9% y/y to $2,513M on higher volumes and prices in all segments except Fibers, plus Chemical Intermediates pricing gains from Middle East-driven market tightening. Chemical Intermediates EBIT swung to a $58M profit from a $30M loss as $83M of higher selling prices and lower raw-material and energy costs offset weaker Fibers volume from acetate-tow destocking. Adjusted diluted EPS was $1.97 versus $1.60 a year ago; GAAP diluted EPS rose to $1.59 from $1.20, aided by a $26M favorable tax-provision adjustment tied to the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. The company guided full-year 2026 capex to approximately $400M, paid $0.84 per share in dividends, and repurchased no shares. Cash rose to $691M; long-term debt eased to $4,452M.
